judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is functionally sound and satisfies every acceptance criterion, including summing usage across tool rounds, handling missing per-round usage without NaN/undefined corruption, preserving the existing no-tool test, and updating both `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. For making the signature unambiguous, the candidate both renames the parameter to `totalUsage` and introduces a `TotalUsageMetadata = UsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts` (which the issue's tech notes listed as a key file), whereas the reference only renamed the parameter in `OrchestratorHooks`. Minor divergences from the reference include putting the new multi-round tests in a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file (plus one in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) rather than keeping all tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and leaving `afterModelResponse` under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of moving it to the main specification list and updating the `OrchestratorHooks` doc-block in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md`.
